PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
